name: calc

test_list.description: Decimal addition retains exact decimal equality.
Division or remainder by zero returns a typed error.
Variables and unknown function identifiers are rejected.
Unary minus, exponentiation, and parentheses follow documented precedence.
Generated bounded decimal expressions either evaluate or return typed errors without panicking.

inputs.name: expr
inputs.description: Bounded expression using the documented grammar.

output_description: The exact fixed-scale decimal result or a typed error.
